jobs.title: Software Engineer - Associate
jobs.description:
About The Role

As a Software Engineer on the Fund Accounting team, you'll have the opportunity to shape the platforms and systems that define how our operations run at scale. This is a full-stack, end-to-end engineering role where your contributions — from architecture decisions to shipped features — directly improve efficiency, automation, and accuracy across fund finance workflows used by industry-leading institutions.

You'll partner closely with Product Management through the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering to delivery, building solutions that solve real, high-stakes problems in a domain where precision and scale both matter.

On the technical side, you'll work primarily with Ruby on Rails on the backend and React on the frontend. We value strong engineering fundamentals — if you bring a solid technical foundation and the drive to build exceptional products, you'll have full support to ramp on our technologies through mentorship and hands-on experience.

Familiarity with finance and accounting concepts is a plus. Over time, domain knowledge becomes a meaningful force multiplier when your work is directly automating complex financial processes at the heart of the alternative investments industry.

Responsibilities

Backend feature development using Ruby (3.3.x) and Rails (8.x)
Frontend application development using React and Redux
Development of unit and integration tests using RSpec, Cucumber, and Capybara
Building prototypes and proof-of-concepts (POCs)
Active participation in recurring team meetings and ceremonies
Participation in peer code reviews as part of our SDLC and change management processes

Qualifications

Degree in Software Engineering or a related field is
6+ years of full-stack web application development
6+ years of development experience with React and Ruby on
Experience with frameworks such as Python / Elixir, PHP / Laravel or similar may compensate for less direct Ruby on Rails experience.
6+ years of HTML and CSS development
Strong understanding of relational database concepts, data modeling, normalization, and object-relational mapping (ORM).
Passion for learning and adopting new
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking
Excellent communication
Collaborative approach to software
Proficiency in written and spoken English is required. Portuguese fluency is required for positions based in Portugal.
Prior experience in the ﬁnancial industry, including asset and wealth management, hedge funds, or investment banking, will be valued.

We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office four days, with the flexibility to work remotely one day (Friday). 

Benefits

iCapital offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes a total compensation program consisting of competitive salary, annual performance bonus, and equity for all full-time employees; healthcare with 100% employer-paid health and dental insurance; and generous paid time off (PTO).

For additional information on iCapital Network, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us Twitter: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc

jobs.description:
Job Description

Welcome to Western & Southern Financial Group – Our focus on creating value for our customers through everything we do is foundational to who we are. We provide meaningful and challenging work for our associates, a key facet of our incredible culture that helps make Western & Southern a career destination.

135 years of operating history;

Born as a modest, door-to-door life insurance business and built to last forever
Ranked 372 on Fortune 500
Award winning Talent Development Team
Top 10 for Top Spouse Employer and Military Friendly Employer in 2023
We consider Cincinnati the best place to live, work and celebrate life – that is why we are committed to doing good for our community

Our Culture

We are building our company to thrive and provide value to our customers, business partners and associates over the long term. To accomplish this, we look for professionals who embody our culture of integrity, top-notch performance, collaboration and teamwork. We are committed to hiring and developing associates who are driven to excel, have a strong work ethic and use astute, fact-based and ethical judgment in decision-making.

A Day in the Life –

The Software Developer II position will support a variety of in-house developed and vendor package business applications that are in place to serve our W&S associates and retirees. This position is for a full stack developer responsible for designing and developing solutions to meet business needs, creating and maintaining data integrations across various business applications, and partnering with the HR / Benefits and corporate business areas to test and implement application changes. Skill sets desired include but are not limited to Visual Studio Pro, C# experience, .NET 8, MudBlazor, Entity Framework .NET Core especially LINQ (SQL Server / Oracle), experience in developing design patterns based on Service Based Architecture, experience in developing and consuming REST APIs, CI/CD Devops experience desired, especially TFS. Other desired qualities include strong communication, collaboration skills while working directly with business partners and vendors, troubleshooting skills and an eye for detail. This position is a member of a small application development team supporting a vast number of business applications serving a variety of business processes, serving high-profile business partners who are keenly interested in modernizing our technology footprint. The ideal candidate is someone who is looking for a fast-paced, multi-faceted, and results driven opportunity.

Duties and Responsibilities

Full stack development
Design and develop solutions according to business needs
Create and maintain data integrations across the various business applications
Partner with corporate business areas to test and implement application changes
Application maintenance / support

Tuition Reimbursement
Subsidized affordable parking

On-site Registered Nurse
Career Coaching/Mentoring
Individualized development plans and career pathing
